plan.brief: Write a one-paragraph plan, under 150 words, for a two-week pilot of a small team trying an AI coding assistant.

stages.title: Days 1–2: Select a small team and representative tasks, record baseline delivery time and defects, set code and data safeguards, and introduce the assistant.
Days 3–9: Use the assistant on scoped tasks with human review and tests; track time, defects, costs, and developer feedback.
Day 10: Compare results with baseline, review security and usability concerns, and recommend adopting, adjusting, or stopping the pilot.
